title: Azure Voice Live S2S
description: Shortcut for 'llm' with vendor automatically set to 'voicelive'. Connects the caller to the Azure Voice Live API for real-time speech-to-speech conversation. connectOptions.host is required and names your Microsoft Foundry or Azure Speech resource (e.g. my-resource.services.ai.azure.com). auth takes either apiKey (sent as the api-key query parameter) or accessToken (a Microsoft Entra ID token, sent as a Bearer header). llmOptions.session_update is required and is sent verbatim in Voice Live's flat session shape, so Azure-only settings such as azure_semantic_vad, azure_deep_noise_suppression and Azure TTS voices are supported.

vendor.description: The LLM vendor (always 'voicelive' for this shortcut).

connectOptions.description: Connection options for the Voice Live endpoint.

host.description: Required. The Foundry/Speech resource hostname, e.g. my-resource.services.ai.azure.com.

apiVersion.description: The Voice Live api-version. Defaults to 2026-04-10.

agentId.description: Foundry Agent Service agent id. When set, the session is addressed by agent instead of model.

projectId.description: Foundry project id, used together with agentId.

path.description: Overrides the entire websocket path, including the query string. Rarely needed.

session_update.instructions: You are a helpful voice assistant.
